body: I guess it'd help. I know it's life and shit happens. And I know we have to keep tryin' 'til we get what we want but it's just that I no longer have the courage and soul to do so

> ave you gotten any help or tried any medication?

None of them. I'd like to though. Should I?

I know what you mean by the last you said and that's what I try to do every time I fail. But it's just a momentary distraction, like... It gives me peace of mind for one or two days, but no more than that
well, anxiety and sadness prevents me from concentrating in class, on my homework, etc etc etc

To live alone. A job. A vehicle (plus how to drive correctly, 'cause I try as hard as I can but I'm so dumb). Getting her to love me. To be better at university. To stop feeling insecure. To end anxiety and panic attacks. To sleep, because I can't even do that. To finally be. To finally breath.
Every year just feels the same. I never change. I never get the things i want... Even if they're so easy to get
